Name: Tanpoponoko's Custom Map Elements for TMX Loader
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
Thanks to Tanpoponoko for letting me convert & upload [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2380]Tanpoponoko's Custom Map Elements[/url]﻿ to Content Patcher! Now with the ability to create custom buildings, a port to TMX Loader seems only natural.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]

[list=1]
[*][url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url]﻿.﻿
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXLoader﻿[/url]﻿.
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1726]PyTK[/url]﻿.
[*]﻿Download this mod/which parts you want and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game!



[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿

[list=1]
[*]Remove the corresponding [TMX] folder from /Mods.

[/list]
